subject: AcmeCloud adapter rewrite — trial extension & credits request
messages:
From: Samir Rauf <samir@acmecloud.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: AcmeCloud adapter rewrite — timeline impact on pilot

Rachel,

Quick note from the eng side — we discovered that our internal adapter team pushed an API/serialization change last week that breaks the connector we planned to demo with Redwood. The change affects the onboarding schema for events (additional required fields plus nested arrays), so our engineer estimate to update the adapter and validate end-to-end is 3–4 weeks. That pushes our pilot kickoff out and means we’ll likely hit the end of our trial credits before we fully validate the flow.

Can Redwood consider a 45-day trial extension and a small sandbox credit top-up while we do an adapter rewrite? If you want, I can attach the stack traces / recent failure logs. We’re committed to the pilot but need runway.

Thanks,
Samir
Engineering Manager — Integrations
AcmeCloud

Attachments: integration-log.txt (text/plain)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rauf <samir@acmecloud.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud adapter rewrite — timeline impact on pilot

Samir —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching the log. I’ve reviewed the failure snippets (thanks) and looped in our Solutions/Finance leads (cc: David, Laura) to evaluate a short extension + sandbox credit. We want to be helpful here since this is a high-fit pilot.

Request summary: 45-day trial extension + $2k sandbox credit (to cover integration validation and a second demo run). Attached I’m including a quick one-page term note for an extension, plus the integration log you sent.

Proposed next steps:
- David: can you confirm if we can offer a 45-day extension and the $2k top-up under our pilot support policy? If not, what’s the approved alternative (duration/amount)?
- Laura: if finance is good, can you approve a small promotional credit and sign the attached note (proposal-trial-terms.pdf)?
- Samir: once we confirm, we’ll send an updated pilot timeline and a short mutual action plan to keep momentum.

If you’d prefer a shorter extension (30 days) + incremental credits, say so and we’ll move faster on approvals.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposal-trial-terms.pdf (application/pdf)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AcmeCloud adapter rewrite — timeline impact on pilot

Rachel —

Cutting to the ask: 45 days + $2k. Policy note: for mid-market pilots we can approve up to 30 days + $1k without director sign-off; anything above requires a quick manager approval and tracking in HubSpot as a one-time promotion. If this is strategic (ACV potential > $150k) we can make an exception with a 45-day runway and the $2k as a promotional credit — I’ll need Laura’s confirmation on the funding code and a one-sentence justification for the promotion.

Suggested language for records: "Approve 45-day trial extension and $2,000 sandbox credit for AcmeCloud pilot (DEAL-7892) due to integration adapter rewrite blocking onboarding. Promotion coded to MARKETING-PILOT-2026."

Laura — can you confirm whether MARKETING-PILOT-2026 has capacity? If not, propose the alternate code and we’ll route for a quick sign-off from Finance.

-David
VP, Sales Ops (acting)
